findings.highlight: I told her we should do our best
findings.governingReading: これからよろしく is the conventional request/greeting “I look forward to working with you” or “let’s get along from here on”; it pairs with Saber firmly shaking the offered hand.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s greeting to Saber is changed into a promise that they should “do their best.”

findings.evidenceJa: 前に出るととばっちり食らうわよ
findings.governingReading: Rin warns Shirou that moving forward will expose him to collateral blows.
findings.explanation: A warning that Shirou could be caught in the fighting becomes a complaint that he obstructs it; the later dialogue does separately make that complaint.

findings.highlight: If you died trying to make a difference, well, that happens
findings.evidenceJa: 色々やって死ぬんならしょうがないけど
findings.governingReading: 色々やって死ぬんならしょうがない means that if Shirou dies while trying to do something, so be it; it does not say the effort would be useful or make a difference.
findings.explanation: Rin’s allowance for dying while attempting something is recast as trying to “make a difference.”

findings.governingReading: The name in Japanese is イリヤスフィール; the established romanization begins with a capital I, followed by two lowercase l’s.

findings.evidenceJa: 体があるかぎり出来る事はある筈だ
findings.governingReading: 体があるかぎり centers the body he still possesses as the means by which he may be able to do something.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s claim that he can act as long as he has a body is changed into a claim that he can act as long as he is alive.

findings.evidenceJa: 鎧さえ汚さず踏み込み
findings.governingReading: 鎧さえ汚さず means she advances without even getting her armor dirty amid flying dirt and shattered tombstones.
findings.explanation: Saber’s armor stays clean in the source, but the English says it is not scratched.

findings.highlight: a battle that is nearly impossible for humans
findings.evidenceJa: 人の身では到底及ばない戦い
findings.governingReading: 人の身では到底及ばない says a human being cannot possibly reach or equal this level of fighting.
findings.explanation: A fight beyond human capability is reduced to one that is merely “nearly impossible” for humans.

findings.evidenceJa: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる旋風
findings.governingReading: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる describes the whirlwind’s result in blunt, bodily terms: anything it touches is turned into a mass of meat in an instant.
findings.explanation: The concrete image of being reduced to a lump of flesh is abstracted into “fatal destruction.”

findings.highlight: Even if he aims perfectly, it won't do any damage
findings.evidenceJa: 直撃したところでバーサーカーには傷一つ負わせられない物
findings.governingReading: 直撃したところで means even if the bow’s projectile directly hits Berserker; it still cannot inflict a single wound.
findings.explanation: A direct hit on Berserker is changed into Archer aiming perfectly.
